decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already captures the Hero V terminal refinement, geometry-preservation constraint, revised system role, and removal of the obsolete fixed-geometry reference.
A same-message MODIFY already applies the restrained architectural terminal to the É accent while its literal correspondence with the Hero V remains valid.
A same-message MODIFY already replaces the prior comparison task with the requested comparative terminal interpretations and preservation constraints.
A same-message MODIFY already records that only the shared terminal is open to refinement while the established structures, slopes, hierarchy, derivation, and alignment remain locked.
The source limits the terminal refinement to the Hero V, second V, and É accent and does not change the E or L construction requirements.
Postponing material application while terminal studies are performed does not change the selected Satin Reflection finish or its required character.
The client explicitly preserves the second V's established structure and slope and makes no change to its height hierarchy.
The same message's selection of Option 2 Balanced Flow is already represented by a candidate MODIFY; the terminal refinement does not otherwise alter kerning.
The shared terminal treatment does not retract or modify the existing requirement that the Hero V and É accent peaks align on the same horizontal reference.
Changing the geometry of the shared terminal does not change which wordmark elements receive champagne gold.
The terminal study has no effect on the selected all-caps wordmark treatment.
Refining the terminals while preserving established geometry does not change the shared-baseline requirement.
